We are seeking a skilled Integration Engineer with expertise in SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) and enterprise system integrations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining integrations between SailPoint IIQ and various enterprise applications, directories, and ITSM platforms. This role requires strong experience with REST/SOAP APIs, Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle EBS, and ServiceNow to ensure seamless identity governance and automated access management processes.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
4–7 years of experience in IAM/IGA implementations and enterprise application integrations.
Hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) integration and connector development.
Strong understanding of identity provisioning, reconciliation, and access management concepts.
Experience integrating with on-premises and cloud-based applications.
r: li
Design, develop, and support integrations between SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) and enterprise applications.
li
Configure and maintain connectors for Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), ServiceNow , and other target systems.
li
Develop and consume REST and SOAP APIs for identity provisioning, reconciliation, and access governance processes.
li
Configure account aggregation, provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement management workflows within SailPoint IIQ.
li
Implement and troubleshoot application onboarding activities and connector configurations.
li
Collaborate with IAM architects, security teams, and business stakeholders to gather and translate integration requirements into technical solutions.
li
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve integration issues while ensuring system performance and reliability.
li
Participate in Identity Lifecycle Management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) implementation and support activities.
li
Develop and maintain technical documentation, integration specifications, and deployment guides.
li
Support testing, deployment, and production rollouts of IAM integrations.
